description: Checks up to 10 EU EORI customs numbers (incl. XI) live in the European Commission's EOS validation service. Returns registered / not registered, and name and address where the holder agreed to publish them. GB EORI numbers are not supported.

eori_numbers.description: 1 to 10 EORI numbers with country code, e.g. DE1234567890123.

with_receipt.description: Optional, default false. Set true only when the user asks for a signed receipt of this check for their files.

name: check_eori
title: Check EORI numbers
